page.notes: Blank verso with show-through. The faint, mirrored lettering across the upper and middle part of the page (a title block of the form "IVSTI LIPSI / DE / MILITIA ROMANA / LIBRI QVINQVE" with a woodcut device and an imprint line below) comes from the printed title page on the other side and is not transcribed. Excluded as well: the handwritten "2" at the top left, the edge of the neighbouring page at the right, and the digitiser's credit line at the bottom left.
